newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Eupe shares debut at 3.0 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Eupe shares debut at 3.0 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian property firm Eupe Corp Bhd made their market debut at 3.0 ringgit against an offer price of 2.0 ringgit.
The company offered 15 million new and vendor shares for its listing on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Eupe forecast net profit of 19.65 million ringgit for the year ended February 28, 1998, and gross earnings per share (EPS) of 23.0 cents based on the enlarged number of shares.
The company reported net profit of 15.15 million ringgit and gross EPS of 17.86 cents last year, with turnover at 68.44 million ringgit.
Around 0142 GMT, the stock was at 3.0 ringgit on volume of 3.73 million shares traded. It has traded between 2.98 and 3.06 ringgit.
